name: Street Code
desc:
🌟 Welcome to Code Street! 🌟
Dive into New Yolk—a city where YOU choose your destiny!

🔥 Newbie to Legend
Start as a fresh-faced rookie on the streets. Will you be a gangster 😈 causing chaos, or a chill civilian 😎 vibing in penthouses? Your choices = your rep!

🗺️ Explore New Yolk’s neon skyscrapers, sketchy alleys, and lit hangouts!

💸 GET THAT BAG
Rob banks 💰, race supercars 🏎️, own mega-mansions—live like a BOSS!

🚨Outsmart cops 🚔 with wacky gadgets

🔫 CRAZY WEAPONS
Battle gangs using SICK Guitar Blaster🎸 or Kawaii Wing Shooter✨  (yes, really!)

💼Switch roles ANYTIME: you can be police officer, a mom, a baby or delivery...Go wild!
